name: Radosław Jasiński
title: Game Developer • M.Sc. in Computer Science (Computer Graphics)

sections.title: Profile
sections.text: Unity game developer with an M.Sc. in Computer Science (Computer Graphics). Six games published on itch.io, two game jam awards, and two theses on machine-learning opponents in games.

entries.title: Machine Learning FPS
entries.subtitle: Unity 6, ML-Agents
entries.description: Master’s thesis. 1v1 arena shooter with bots trained by PPO self-play.

entries.title: Defuse or Lose
entries.subtitle: Unity, co-op puzzle
entries.description: Co-op bomb defusal with 8 levels of randomized puzzles and hazards. Team of two.

entries.title: Cars vs Chickens
entries.subtitle: Unity, arcade lane defence
entries.description: Reverse tower defence built in 10 days for WitchJam 2026. Team of three.

entries.title: Dungeon’s Whisper
entries.subtitle: Unity, dark fantasy roguelike
entries.description: Procedurally generated dungeons, items, bosses. Led a 16-person team.

entries.title: The Reaver King
entries.subtitle: Unity, ML-Agents
entries.description: Engineering thesis. Shoot ’em up with a computer player trained by PPO.

entries.title: Zombie Killer
entries.subtitle: Unity, Blender
entries.description: PS2-style FPS demo with ragdoll physics, own low-poly models and animations.

entries.title: 3rd place — WitchJam 2026
entries.subtitle: Kielce University of Technology & Fool’s Theory
entries.description: Game jam, theme “On the other side”. Built Cars vs Chickens, an arcade lane defence game with low-poly graphics.

entries.title: Honorable mention — PoliJam 2025
entries.subtitle: Kielce University of Technology & 11 bit studios
entries.description: Week-long game jam, theme “The clock is ticking”. Built Defuse or Lose, a 2D co-op puzzle game played against a timer.
